description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.12.1

      A patch release: no public type or member added, removed or renamed. Results for finite input are the same to the
      bit (9 950 fuzzed calls); what changed is the answer to shapes with a coordinate that is not a finite number, and
      four DXF and DWG details measured against AutoCAD 2021.

      FIXED, shapes that are not finite
      - A shape whose every point is NaN, or a probe point of NaN, meets nothing: 993 members that reported a meeting
        with one (CollidesWith, DistanceTo at 0 or 1.8E+308, GetClosestEdge, GetIntersections, Contains, Locate) are
        down to 47, all of the closest-point family. A distance with nothing finite to measure is NaN.
      - A region with a vertex that is not finite holds nothing (Contains((-10, 50)) of a square with a corner of NaN was
        true), and the booleans take such an operand as the empty region.
      - A member that has to make something of a shape that is not finite throws InvalidOperationException "The shape has
        a coordinate that is not a finite number." in all 271 places, where 132 had a message of their own; arguments
        that are the cause are named; GeoLine3.GetPlaneWith names inPlaneDirection for a direction along the line.

      FIXED and CHANGED, DXF and DWG
      - The jog angle of a dimension style (DIMJOGANG) is written to and read from DWG in radians, as AutoCAD keeps it:
        a style with the default 45 degrees was read by AutoCAD 2021 as 58 degrees.
      - A DXF whose header leaves out MEASUREMENT, the DIM variables, DIMSTYLE or CELTYPE is read with AutoCAD's values
        for them (DIMASZ 0.18, DIMSTYLE Standard, CELTYPE Continuous), not the library's metric ones.
      - DxfEntity.SetDatabaseDefaults gives the entity the drawing's CETRANSPARENCY too, in R2004 and later.
      - A block keeps its ENDBLK as it was read or made.

      The CAD app that was built in this repository (GeometryHelper.Cad, never published) is now OpenCAD2D, in a
      repository of its own: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/opencad2d

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
